snippet.title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect - Hazama DLC + ICEY Crossover + New Boss Reki (Anniversary Pack Release)
snippet.description:
Hey everyone, our Anniversary Pack with Hazama DLC, ICEY crossover and new boss Reki is live with 30% off on the base game, 25% off launch discount on the Hazama DLC and 25% off on the Rachel DLC. 

For more details of this biggest ever update, please check out our Steam post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2273430/view/764023459821912172

Base game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2273430/BlazBlue_Entropy_Effect/
Hazama DLC page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422870/BlazBlue_Entropy_Effect__Hazama_Character_Pack/
